# Joker Tattoo

> Joker Tattoo is a premium custom tattoo studio in Patong, Phuket, creating Japanese, realism, Sak Yant, black and grey, fine line, cover-up and large-scale tattoo work for travellers and local clients.

## Key facts

- Address: 91 Nanai Rd, Tambon Patong, Amphoe Kathu, Patong, Phuket 83150, Thailand
- Phone: +66 64 858 7105
- Email: jokertattoopatongth@gmail.com
- Hours: Daily, 1:00 PM to 8:00 PM
- Services: Custom tattoos, Japanese tattoos, realism tattoos, Sak Yant, black and grey, fine line, cover-ups and large-scale tattoos.
- Booking: Customers can request an appointment online and receive a personal reply from the studio.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://www.jokertattoopatong.com/): Studio overview, tattoo styles and booking information.
- [Tattoo Gallery](https://www.jokertattoopatong.com/gallery): Selected work by Joker Tattoo artists.
- [Why Joker](https://www.jokertattoopatong.com/why-joker): Services, consultations, hygiene standards, client reasons, frequently asked questions and booking.
- [Contact](https://www.jokertattoopatong.com/contact): Studio address, opening hours and appointment request.
